name: sheet-busts
prompt: The reference shows our six game characters (top row: warrior, farmer, miner; bottom row: demolitions, builder, healer). Draw a head-and-shoulders portrait of each one for HUD icons, in the same 3-by-2 arrangement and the same order, each facing three-quarter to the right with a confident expression, same faces, hair, headgear and team-teal scarves as the reference, cut off cleanly at mid-chest. Style: our stylised 3D game look (hand-painted 3D render, soft toon shading in three value steps, light from the upper left, a bold dark navy (#18233B) outline of even width around every object), chunky readable shapes that stay clear when shown at 40 pixels. Background perfectly flat pure white (#FFFFFF), no shadows, no glow halos, no text, no labels, no numbers, no frames, no circles or tiles behind the objects. Each item sits centred in its own cell of an invisible grid with wide white space between items; items never touch.
